messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-84721 - gpu-pool-3 memory pressure (severity: high) - 2024-11-03T02:33:07Z
Incident Bot: Summary: sustained cudaErrorMemoryAllocation errors on nodes gpu-3a/gpu-3b. Auto-shedder triggered. Affected route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-13b-quant).
PagerDuty Bot: Incident PD-INC-84721 triggered, assigned to on-call: Alex Chen.
Alex Chen: acked PD-INC-84721 :raised_hand: I'm on it. First check: how widespread?
Samir Patel: seeing a spike in GPU alloc failures in logs from both regions-us-west-2a and -2b. Error rates up ~14% last 5m.
Maya Lopez: customer-impact estimate? any 5xx from the edge?
Samir Patel: yes, ~2.3% 5xx on generation endpoints, mostly timeouts after kernel failures, some clients retrying.
Alex Chen: good to know. Paging L2 (Nikhil) because this looks like mem leak/fragmentation. @Nikhil Rao can you join?
Nikhil Rao: joining. pulling logs now.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: GPU Memory Pressure -> steps: 1) identify offending job/container 2) drain pool 3) restart process 4) if persistent, fallback to cpu. Link: https://runbooks.internal/gpu-memory-pressure
Alex Chen: running kubectl to list pods on gpu-3a:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-3a -o wide
# pod: embedder-prod-7f8c9 (OOMs: 4), gen-prod-12b3 (healthy), kv-cache-2 (evictions high)
```
Samir Patel: logs snippet from embedder-prod-7f8c9:
```
2024-11-03T02:31:45Z ERROR runtime: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
stack: runtime/inference/gpu_pool.go:217 allocate -> kvcache.go:89 getSlice
2024-11-03T02:31:46Z WARN auto-shedder: evicting 12 cached prefixes to free 1.2GB
```
Maya Lopez: looks like embedder instance is the hot spot. Suggest cordon + drain node gpu-3a and let autoscaler move workloads.
Alex Chen: marking node for drain:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-3a
kubectl drain gpu-3a -n inference --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Incident Bot: Auto-shedder action recorded: pool embedder-pool-3 evicted caches on 3 hosts.
Nikhil Rao: while drain in progress, flip traffic away from embedder-pool-3 via routing policy.
Samir Patel: applying routing override to route embedding traffic to embedder-pool-1, pool-2:
```
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/embed --exclude-pool embedder-pool-3 --reason "OOM drain"
```
Alex Chen: rolling restart of embedder pods on gpu-3b to clear fragmentation:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedder-prod -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-3b
```
Maya Lopez: monitoring token-level errors and latency.
Samir Patel: after the drain, error rate dropped from 14% -> 1.1% over 6 minutes. 5xxs down to 0.2%.
Alex Chen: great. marking PD incident as acknowledged and noting mitigation steps. Will keep open for 30m to ensure no relapse.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-INC-84721 acknowledged by Alex Chen (on-call).
Nikhil Rao: I'm going to inspect driver versions and recent kernel changes on gpu-3a, just in case. if it's fragmentation we'll consider a hotpatch to the allocator or bumping kv-cache eviction policy.
Samir Patel: quick temporary mitigation: reducing max_batch_tokens for embedder to lower memory footprint:
```
kubectl set env deployment/embedder-prod MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=1024 -n inference
```
Alex Chen: customer impact note for postmortem: "Transient GPU memory allocation failures caused ~2.3% 5xx on generation endpoints for ~12 minutes; primary root cause: fragmented KV cache and sustained high prefix cache use on embedder-pool-3 leading to OOMs."
Maya Lopez: tagging impacted customers: search-api-uk, content-summarize-prod. Notified account reps.
ops-runbook-bot: If issues recur after restart, escalate to platform infra (pagerduty L2) and consider immediate node reprovisioning.
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation level set to L2 and message sent to #platform-pager.
Alex Chen: leaving handoff in 20m to Nikhil for follow-ups and driver/kernel checks. Nikhil, please add any config changes to the incident doc.
Nikhil Rao: will do. initial hypothesis: long-lived kv-cache entries + a recent spike in prefix-heavy traffic caused fragmentation -> allocator thrashing. Plan: analyze KV cache hit patterns, consider TTL reduction and proactive eviction.
Alex Chen: closing oncall thread for now, keeping PD incident open. If we see >1% error for >10m we re-open. thanks team. :tada:
PagerDuty Bot: PD-INC-84721 status: monitoring.
